name: acqkevin
label: Number of Kevin R is acquainted with

questions.text:
Cases in Sample B (Ballots 4-6) should receive this variable. This variable is used to drive skips in a module. This  variable should have a value of 1-5 using the following proportions: 1=50pct, 2,3,4,5 = 12.5pct each.
